claims: The Artemis II mission is designed as a roughly 10-day flight.
The Artemis II mission flight duration is approximately 9 days, 1 hour, and 46 minutes.
The Artemis II mission will send four astronauts around the Moon and back to Earth.
The Artemis II mission is a crewed test flight.
The Artemis II mission will utilize a free-return trajectory.
The Artemis II mission will loop around the far side of the Moon.
The Artemis II mission will splash down in the Pacific Ocean.
The Artemis II mission trajectory is a lunar flyby with a free-return trajectory.
The goal of the Artemis II mission is the first crewed test of the Orion spacecraft systems.
The Artemis II mission distance is over 230,000 miles (370,000+ km) from Earth.
The Artemis II mission crew consists of 4 astronauts.
The Artemis II mission includes testing life support systems.
The Artemis II mission includes testing navigation.
The Artemis II mission includes conducting crew activities before returning to Earth.
